I implemented `slugify` in `text_tools.py`, but I couldn't run the tests. Every PowerShell call was denied because no interactive approval was available.

The function lowercases the text and removes any character that isn't a lowercase letter, digit, whitespace or hyphen. It then turns whitespace runs into single hyphens and strips leading and trailing hyphens. I checked it by hand against the three cases in `tests/test_slugify.py`: `'Hello World'`, `'C++ & you!'` and `'  a   b  '`. All three give the expected results.

I also left a stray scratch file, `text_tools.py.new`, in the repo root. I created it while working and couldn't delete it for the same reason, so please remove it.

To run the tests, use `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`.
